target.role: Analyst / Senior Analyst, Total Plan Risk Management

summary: Applying for the Analyst / Senior Analyst, Total Plan Risk Management role at OMERS with ~7 years of experience across total-portfolio risk analytics, asset-liability studies, and quantitative research for pension and institutional investors. Hands-on with VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, risk decomposition, stress and scenario analysis, LDI, and liquidity risk on multi-asset mandates — including direct experience with Ortec's GLASS platform. Strong Python fluency for large-dataset analytical workflows; CFA charterholder with dual MSc in Financial Modelling and Engineering.

roles.title: Asst. Director, Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Total Portfolio Risk Analytics & Investment Risk Insights
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement; cumulative ~$50bn book of work — independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics — duration, key-rate sensitivities, and cross-asset interactions — feeding downstream investment risk reporting and risk-governance processes.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; cross-check sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio aggregates for consistency and economic defensibility.

sections.heading: Stress Testing, Scenario Analysis & Liquidity Risk Research
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — delivering forward-looking liquidity risk visibility across multi-year asset-liability horizons.

Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and portfolio construction decisions under stressed market conditions.
Embedded behavioral cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays into scenario research workflows aligned with executive contingency planning.

sections.heading: Risk Reporting Tools & Large-Dataset Analytics
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines sourcing large datasets across multi-asset portfolios and feeding senior-stakeholder risk reporting.

Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities; translated quantitative outputs into investment-committee-ready narratives.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) for code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection — reducing development cycle time an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules.

Onboarded U.S. and Canadian pension funds and asset managers onto an enterprise multi-asset analytics platform (PFaroe); validated asset, liability, and ALM configurations against client investment-team requirements.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM, scoping client needs into structured Product Owner requests for development.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation engagements for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness processes.

Delivered asset-liability studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors; analyzed funded status, duration mismatch, and long-horizon balance-sheet risk under stochastic regimes.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization and portfolio construction analysis based on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform; conducted risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk analysis, and near-optimal frontier robustness analysis to test allocation recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators to assess interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Conducted LDI analysis on multi-asset mandates: duration alignment, hedging trade-offs, and liquidity risk considerations supporting Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation decisions.

Modelled pension actuarial liabilities alongside major investment products and economic variables; performed cash-flow, liquidity risk, and hedging analysis across rates, inflation, and FX for institutional clients.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger (jointly-sponsored plan); on a team of three, developed and validated the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics and evaluated duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
Presented findings at on-site client meetings, including investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
